data.name: Extended Barrel III Blueprint
data.description: Lets you craft an Extended Barrel III
data.article: The Extended Barrel III Blueprint is a blueprint that allows you to craft an extended barrel attachment at the Workbench. It improves how fast bullets travel from your weapons.

data.name: Extended Burst Cycles
data.description: A burst has a beginning, a middle, and an end. The middle could probably use more bullets. Let's investigate.

data.name: Extended Light Mag I
data.description: Slightly extends the ammo capacity of compatible weapons that use light ammo.
data.article:
Extended Light Mag I is a Weapon Mod that makes compatible weapons hold slightly more ammunition. It adds 5 to the magazine size of compatible weapons.

You can find this mod by scavenging, or craft it at a Gunsmith bench level 1. It is also sold by the vendor Tian Wen for 1,920 coins, with a limit of 5 per day.

data.name: Extended Light Mag II
data.description: Moderately extends the ammo capacity of compatible weapons that use light ammo.
data.article: The Extended Light Mag II is a weapon modification that increases the amount of ammunition a compatible weapon can hold. It adds 10 rounds to a weapon's magazine capacity. To craft this modification, you need the Extended Light Mag II Blueprint and access to a crafting station. This item can also be recycled to recover some resources.

data.name: Extended Light Mag II Blueprint
data.description: Lets you craft a Extended Light Mag II
data.article: The Extended Light Mag II Blueprint is a blueprint that allows you to craft the Extended Light Mag II weapon mod at a Gunsmith Bench, which helps by increasing the ammo capacity of compatible weapons. Blueprints for gun parts, such as this one, are typically found when scavenging Raider Containers, which can appear in any map. They may also be obtained as a reward from Trials. Once you use a blueprint, it is consumed and the recipe becomes permanently available for crafting. If you find a blueprint you already know, it can be sold for 5,000 coins.

data.name: Extended Light Mag III
data.description: Significantly extends the ammo capacity of compatible weapons that use light ammo.
data.article:
The Extended Light Mag III is a weapon modification that increases the ammunition capacity of compatible weapons.

You can craft the Extended Light Mag III at a Gunsmith Bench level 1 after acquiring the Extended Light Mag III Blueprint.

data.name: Extended Light Mag III Blueprint
data.description: Lets you craft a Extended Light Mag III
data.article: The Extended Light Mag III Blueprint is a blueprint that allows you to craft the Extended Light Mag III modification at a Gunsmith Bench level 1. This weapon mod significantly increases the ammunition capacity of compatible weapons.

data.name: Extended Medium Mag I
data.description: Slightly extends the ammo capacity of compatible weapons that use medium ammo.
data.article: Extended Medium Mag I is a weapon modification. It helps by increasing the ammunition capacity for weapons that use medium ammo.

data.name: Extended Medium Mag II
data.description: Moderately extends the ammo capacity of compatible weapons that use medium ammo.

stat_block.compatibleWeapons: Arpeggio, Osprey, Renegade, Torrente, Tempest, Venator

data.article:
The Extended Medium Mag II is a weapon modification that moderately increases the amount of ammo your compatible weapons can hold. This allows you to fire more shots before needing to reload.

You can obtain this mod by scavenging in the world. It can also be crafted at a Gunsmith station using the Extended Medium Mag II Blueprint and various other materials. Additionally, the vendor Shani sells this mod for 100 coins, with a daily limit of two per Raider. If you no longer need it, this mod can be recycled into other resources.

data.name: Extended Medium Mag II Blueprint
data.description: Lets you craft a Extended Medium Mag II
data.article: The Extended Medium Mag II Blueprint is a blueprint that allows you to create the Extended Medium Mag II at a crafting station with a Gunsmith skill level of 2. This weapon attachment increases the ammo capacity of compatible weapons that use medium ammo, letting you fire more shots before needing to reload. You can purchase this blueprint from the vendor Shani for 100 coins, with a daily limit of two. It can also be found through scavenging.

data.name: Extended Medium Mag III
data.description: Significantly extends the ammo capacity of compatible weapons that use medium ammo.
data.article: The Extended Medium Mag III is a weapon mod. Its main purpose is to increase the amount of ammunition a compatible weapon can hold, allowing for more shots before reloading. This mod is crafted at Gunsmith Bench level 1 using the Extended Medium Mag III Blueprint. If you have extra units of this mod, you can recycle or salvage it to recover various other resources.

data.name: Extended Medium Mag III Blueprint
data.description: Lets you craft the Medium Mag III
data.article:
This is a blueprint that allows you to craft the Extended Medium Mag III weapon mod at a Gunsmith bench. Once crafted, it helps your compatible weapons hold a significantly larger amount of ammunition.

For a better chance to find the Extended Medium Mag III Blueprint, focus on Night Raids or Electromagnetic Storms, and target high-value loot zones or Residential-style containers, including suitcases on Spaceport and cupboards on Buried City Night Raid.

data.name: Extended Shotgun Mag I
data.description: Slightly extends the ammo capacity of shotguns.
data.article: The Extended Shotgun Mag I is a weapon modification designed to slightly extend the ammo capacity of compatible shotguns. Equipping this mod allows Raiders to carry more ammunition in their weapon, reducing the frequency of reloads during combat encounters.

data.name: Extended Shotgun Mag II
data.description: Moderately extends the ammo capacity of shotguns.
data.article: The Extended Shotgun Mag II is a weapon modification that increases the amount of ammunition a compatible weapon can hold. This helps you carry more ammunition into raids before needing to reload or resupply. You can craft this item at a Gunsmith station once you have its blueprint, using various resources. It can also be recycled for resources.

data.name: Extended Shotgun Mag II Blueprint
data.description: Lets you craft a Extended Shotgun Mag II - Moderately extends the ammo capacity of shotguns.
data.article: The Extended Shotgun Mag II Blueprint is a blueprint that allows you to craft the Extended Shotgun Mag II weapon mod at a Gunsmith bench level 1. This mod moderately increases the ammo capacity of shotguns. Blueprints can be obtained through scavenging, by completing Weekly Trials or projects, or as rewards from Quests. Certain ARCs can also drop blueprints. Unwanted blueprints can be sold for 5,000 coins.

data.name: Extended Shotgun Mag III
data.description: Significantly extends the ammo capacity of shotguns.
data.flavor_text: Compatible with: Il Toro, Vulcano
data.article: The Extended Shotgun Mag III is a weapon modification that extends the ammo capacity of shotguns by 6 rounds. It is compatible with weapons like the Il Toro and Vulcano. You can craft this modification at a Gunsmith bench level 3 or higher once you have the Extended Shotgun Mag III Blueprint and the necessary materials.

data.name: Extended Shotgun Mag III Blueprint
data.description: Lets you craft a Extended Shotgun Mag III
data.article: The Extended Shotgun Mag III Blueprint is a blueprint that allows you to craft the Extended Shotgun Mag III at the Gunsmith. This weapon modification for shotguns significantly increases ammunition capacity.

data.description: Used to craft medical supplies and shields.

data.name: Faded Flush (Aviator Color)
data.description: A new cosmetic variant will be added to your collection.
data.article: The Faded Flush (Aviator Color) is a cosmetic option that lets you change the color scheme of your character's Aviator appearance. This allows you to personalize how your character looks in the game.

data.name: Faded Photograph
data.description: A snapshot of the world before, faded by sunlight and time.
data.article: The Faded Photograph is a collectible trinket that displays an old image, worn by time and sunlight. This item serves as a resource and may be needed for certain quests. Raiders obtain it by scavenging within Residential areas of the Buried City map.

data.name: Familiar Duck
data.description: Unlike the real one, this one fits in your pack.
data.flavor_text: Can be thrown to create noise.
data.article: The Familiar Duck is an Epic Trinket that can be thrown to create noise, which is useful for distracting ARCs. It can also be placed in your stash to decorate the Raider Den. This item is a variant of the Rubber Duck; other variants include the Alien Duck, Doodly Duck, Flashy Duck, Gentle Duck, and Tropical Duck. Raiders can find this item by scavenging inside chimneys when Bird City is active.

data.name: Fancy Plate
data.description: Careful not to shatter it.

data.name: Ferro I
data.description: Packs a punch, but must be reloaded between every shot.
data.flavor_text: Very effective against ARC armor plating
data.article:
The Ferro I is a break-action Battle Rifle that uses Heavy Ammo. It offers an effective option for engaging targets from medium to long distances, though its necessary reload between shots means it can be less ideal for very close fights. It's often provided as part of the kit for Raiders choosing a Free Loadout.

You can find the Ferro I by scavenging in various areas, purchase it from Tian Wen, or craft it at a Workbench once you have the Gunsmith 1 skill. This weapon can also be upgraded into more advanced versions, and it can be recycled for useful resources.

data.name: Ferro II
data.description: Packs a punch, but must be reloaded between every shot.
data.flavor_text: Very effective against ARC armor plating
data.article:
The Ferro II is an improved version of the Ferro I, a break-action battle rifle that uses heavy ammo. This weapon is useful for fighting ARCs from medium to long distances, particularly due to its effectiveness against ARC armor. Compared to the base Ferro I, the Ferro II reloads 13% faster and has increased durability.

You can craft the Ferro II at a Gunsmith workbench in your Hideout by upgrading an existing Ferro I. It can also be purchased from Tian Wen. Sometimes, Raiders who choose a Free Loadout may receive this weapon as part of their starting gear. Once acquired, it can be further upgraded into Ferro III or recycled into other resources.

data.name: Ferro III
data.description: Packs a punch, but must be reloaded between every shot.
data.flavor_text: Very effective against ARC armor plating
data.article: The Ferro III is an upgraded version of the Ferro break-action Battle Rifle, which is effective for engaging enemies at medium to long distances. It uses Heavy Ammo. This specific version features a 26% reduced reload time and 20 additional durability points, providing practical improvements during combat. You can craft it at a Gunsmith bench using other materials. It can also be recycled for resources.

data.name: Ferro IV
data.description: Packs a punch, but must be reloaded between every shot.
data.flavor_text: Very effective against ARC armor plating
data.article:
The Ferro IV is an upgraded Battle Rifle that uses Heavy Ammo. It is designed for medium-to-long range combat and offers improved durability and significantly faster reloading compared to earlier versions of the weapon.

It is crafted by upgrading a Ferro III at a Workbench. This weapon can be repaired to restore its durability, recycled or salvaged for resources, and sold to vendors for coins.

data.name: Fertilizer
data.description: May be worth a few coins.
data.article: Fertilizer is a material used to help plants grow, often described as special dirt. It is needed to complete projects like Avian Alarm and is required for the Unexpected Initiative quest, where it must be delivered alongside a Water Pump. You can obtain it by scavenging from garden beds and wicker baskets. It also appears in greenhouses found in the Village on the Blue Gate map, and in hydroponic domes located on the Dam Battlegrounds map. This material can be recycled into other resources and can be sold for coins.

data.name: Film Reel
data.description: May be worth a few coins.
data.article:
A Film Reel is a collectible item that can be sold for coins.

You can find this item inside residential loot containers such as drawers and cabinets. Look for it in the Pale Apartments and Ruby Residence areas of the Dam Battlegrounds map. It also appears in Plaza Rosa and Grandioso Apartments in the Buried City map, and the Village in the Blue Gate map.

data.name: Fine Wristwatch
data.description: Perfect for telling the time, and showcasing that you're an exceedingly dignified person.
data.article: The Fine Wristwatch is a decorative item from an older time that has a base value of 3000 coins. This item can be found by scavenging containers such as lockers. It appears in the Buried City map, the Dam Battlegrounds map, the Blue Gate map, and the Stella Montis map, particularly within commercial and residential areas. It is also obtainable during the Night Raid event.

data.name: Finger Gun Single Shot (Emote)
data.description: A new cosmetic will be added to your collection
data.article: The Finger Gun Single Shot (Emote) is a way for your character to express themselves by performing a hand gesture that looks like shooting a gun. Raiders use this action for non-verbal communication and personal expression during gameplay. You can select this emote from your character's emote wheel.

data.name: Fireball Burner
data.description: Can be recycled into ARC Alloy.

guide_links.label: Destroy Ticks, Fireballs and Pops: Weekly Trials

data.article: The Fireball Burner is a throwable item that creates a small fire when it hits something. This fire damages nearby Fireballs and Raiders within its area. After it's used, you can pick up a Damaged Fireball Burner from where it landed. This item is important for upgrading your Refiner and is also required to complete the What Goes Around quest. You can also use it to craft other items or recycle it for useful resources. It is obtained by scavenging destroyed ARCs, specifically by defeating Fireballs and Couriers.

data.name: Firecracker
data.description: A device that sparks and pops in a pleasant manner.
data.article: The Firecracker is a common throwable item that creates a pleasant effect when used. Raiders can obtain this item by scavenging, crafting it at a Utility Station using collected resources, or purchasing it from the vendor Shani. If no longer needed, it can be recycled into various materials.

data.name: Firefly Burner
data.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
data.flavor_text: A volatile cansiter that vents fire when shot.
data.article: The Firefly Burner is a volatile canister that can be thrown and shot to vent fire and explode. This item is obtained by defeating Fireflies. Beyond its direct use, it is used to craft various items and is also needed to complete certain projects. It can also be recycled or salvaged to obtain crafting materials.

data.name: Fireworks Box
data.description: A remotely triggered arrangement of dazzling fireworks, sure to put on a show.
data.article: The Fireworks Box is a utility item that launches a dazzling display of fireworks when deployed and remotely triggered. You can craft this item at an Explosives Station after learning the Fireworks Box Blueprint, which is rewarded upon completing the Test Case quest or can be found during the "Cold Snap" map condition. You can also purchase it from Shani for 60 coins, with a daily limit of three. Additionally, three of these items can be obtained from Raider Deck AR/RD 002: Goalie, on Page 2.

data.name: Fireworks Box Blueprint
data.description: Lets you craft a Fireworks Box
data.article: The Fireworks Box Blueprint is a blueprint that lets you craft a Fireworks Box. This blueprint can be found as a reward for completing certain quests. Additionally, it is often discovered in breachable containers and lockers during the Cold Snap event. Raiders have reported finding it in areas like the Water Treatment and Power Generation Complex within the Dam map, in hospital lockers on the Buried City map, and near extraction vents in the Blue Gate map. The blueprint has a value of 5000 coins.

data.name: First Wave Compass
data.description: Dusty but functional, these helped chart a course when when all seemed lost.

data.name: First Wave Rations
data.description: Often heated above discreet fires, these meager provisions are said to have fueled a resistance.

data.name: First Wave Tape
data.description: An old tape found inside a battered old camcorder.

data.name: Flame Spray
data.description: A classic makeshift weapon, sure to leave scorch marks.
data.article: The Flame Spray is an Uncommon Gadget that lets you spray fire at enemies. It is a weapon you craft during a raid, which requires a specific skill called In-Round Crafting. This item can also be obtained from certain Raider Decks, such as the 'IMPROVISATION PACK' found in Raider Deck AR/RD 001: Ryder & Voyager. To repair it, you will need salvage materials.

data.name: Flashy Duck
data.description: Lovingly hand-painted by someone of great talent—clearly. Any guesses who?
data.flavor_text: Can be thrown to create noise.
data.article: The Flashy Duck is a decorative trinket, which is a variant of the rubber duck. You can display it in your Raider Den stash for decoration or throw it during a raid to create noise and distract enemies. This item is found inside chimneys while the Bird City event is active. Other variants include the Alien Duck, Doodly Duck, Familiar Duck, Gentle Duck, and Tropical Duck.

data.name: Flow Controller
data.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
data.article: The Flow Controller is a rare item primarily used for recycling into crafting materials. It is also needed to complete the Snap And Salvage quest, which requires one Magnetron and one Flow Controller. You can find this item by scavenging in the Stella Montis map.

data.name: Flushing Terminal Key
data.description: A pungent key used to operate the Flushing Terminals in the tunnels below Spaceport.
data.article: The Flushing Terminal Key is a quest item used to progress The Stench of Corruption. Raiders use this key to activate a specific Flushing Terminal located in the underground tunnels of the Spaceport map. To obtain it, search a clothing rack in the Staff Locker Room within the Departure Building, also on the Spaceport map.

data.name: Fluted Rotor Core
data.description: Used to craft amplified weapons.

data.name: Food Wrapper
data.description: The vibrant colors and natural stickiness have made them a favorite among the more artistic Speranzans.

data.name: Fossilized Lightning
data.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
data.article: Fossilized Lightning is an Epic item that serves as a crafting resource. You can break it down to obtain other crafting materials. To find this item, you need to be aware of the Electromagnetic Storm map condition; it occasionally appears at the epicenter of lightning strikes during these events. This item is collected by scavenging it from the environment.

data.name: Free Loadout Augment
data.description: Basic augment for rookie Raiders, offering slightly more backpack space and carry capacity.
data.article: The Free Loadout Augment is a basic augment designed to increase a Raider's carrying capacity. It provides slightly more backpack space, allowing for a maximum of 35.0 weight, and is compatible with light shields. Raiders receive this augment at no cost when choosing to deploy with a Free Loadout. It can be exchanged with Lance for other basic augments, such as the Looting Mk. 1, Combat Mk. 1, or Tactical Mk. 1. Additionally, it can be recycled for resources or sold for coins.

data.name: Frequency Modulation Box
data.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
data.article: The Frequency Modulation Box is a rare item. It is needed for specific projects, such as Stage 4 of Expedition 2. You can also recycle it into various resources. These items are found by scavenging objects and containers within the Stella Montis map.

data.name: Fried Motherboard
data.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
data.article: The Fried Motherboard is primarily used to upgrade the Utility Station. You can also recycle it into general crafting materials. Look for Fried Motherboards by scavenging from containers such as Server Racks and Recording Panels.

data.name: Frigate Diagnostic Node
data.description: Found in the trail of ARC Frigates, the electromagnetic signatures of these nodes turn out to be partially decipherable.

data.name: Frigate Inductor
data.description: Can be used to upgrade the Research Station.

data.name: Frosty Duck
data.description: A dapper little fellow.

data.name: Fruit Mix
data.description: A food item that moderately increases both health and stamina.
data.article: The Fruit Mix is a food item that helps you recover. Eating it will increase your health by 25 and your stamina by 50. You can create this item using in-round crafting.

data.name: Frying Pan
data.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
data.article: The Frying Pan is a rare item you can find by searching through the environment, also known as scavenging. It serves a practical purpose as it can be recycled into crafting materials, helping you gather resources for other item projects. Raiders often discover Frying Pans in residential areas, particularly when the Flickering Flames Event is active.

data.name: Garlic Press
data.description: It'll press garlic, olives, and probably many other things.
data.article: The Garlic Press is primarily valued for the materials it provides. It is especially useful for recycling, where it yields salvage. Raiders can also choose to sell this item for coins, and it is known to fetch a higher value than some other common items.

data.name: Dried-Out ARC Resin
data.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
data.article: Dried-Out ARC Resin is a resource that can be recycled for crafting materials. It used to be an intact ARC Synthetic Resin but is now in a damaged state. You can obtain this item by scavenging the husks of defeated ARCs, particularly the Baron Husk.

data.name: Duct Tape
data.description: Used to craft a wide range of items. Can be recycled into crafting materials.
data.article: Duct Tape is a crafting material primarily used to craft weapon modifications. You can find it by scavenging in the environment. It is also obtained by recycling salvage. Additionally, Celeste sells this item for coins.

data.name: Durable Cloth
data.description: Used to craft medical supplies.
data.article:
Durable Cloth is a refined material used to craft medical supplies. It helps you progress by letting you create various items. It is also needed for upgrading the Medical Lab and completing Expedition projects.

You can find Durable Cloth by scavenging in medical and commercial areas, often inside containers such as Industrial Drawers and Blue Multi Drawers. Additionally, it can be crafted at a Refiner using salvage materials. You can also obtain it by recycling salvage or by salvaging other items.

data.name: Dusty Film Reel
data.description: A dusty recording of a solemn corporate announcement.

data.name: Electrical Components
data.description: Used to craft a wide range of items. Can be recycled into crafting materials.
data.flavor_text: Used to craft: Tactical Mk.2, Combat Mk.2, Looting Mk.2, Advanced Electrical Components, Surge Shield Recharger
data.article:
Electrical Components are refined materials used for crafting items like Jolt Mines and Surge Shield Rechargers. They are also needed to upgrade your Gear Bench and Utility Station, and for Expedition projects.

You can find these components by defeating ARCs such as the Rocketeer, Vaporizer, Android, and Arc Courier. They are often looted from containers like Breachable Containers, Bags, and Cars. Exploration in the Blue Gate, Stella Montis, Spaceport, Buried City, and Dam Battlegrounds maps can also yield them, particularly during events like Night Raid and Harvester. You can also craft them at a Refiner or recycle them for resources.

Raiders can obtain empty wine bottles by salvaging salvage, or by finding them as loot in Residential and Commercial areas.

data.name: Energy Clip
data.description: Ammo used for energy weapons. One clip will fully charge a single weapon.
data.article:
Energy Clips are a type of ammunition used for recharging energy weapons like the Jupiter, Equalizer, and Dolabra. One clip fully recharges a single weapon. This ammunition is effective at penetrating ARC armor, performing at least as well as Heavy Ammo.

You can get Energy Clips in several ways:

  • They are salvaged from defeated ARCs.
  • You can find them by scavenging in the environment.
  • They can be crafted at a Workbench.
  • They are sold by the vendor Tian Wen.

data.name: Epoxy Bucket
data.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.

data.name: Equalizer
data.description: A high capacity experimental beam rifle.
data.flavor_text: Extremely effective against ARC armor plating and limbs
data.article: The Equalizer is a fully-automatic Special Beam Rifle that fires energy-based projectiles. Raiders can craft this weapon at the Gunsmith after learning the Equalizer Blueprint.

data.name: Equalizer Blueprint
data.description: A high capacity experimental beam rifle.
data.article: The Equalizer Blueprint is a blueprint that allows you to craft the Equalizer at Gunsmith. This fully-automatic special beam rifle fires energy-based projectiles. You can obtain it by finding it inside the Harvester.

data.name: Equatorial Sundial
data.description: A marvel of ancient ingenuity, those with a penchant for stargazing may find the mesmerizing patterns oddly familiar.

data.name: Espresso Machine Parts
data.description: Replacement parts salvaged from an espresso machine.

data.name: ESR Analyzer
data.description: A portable analyzer from the world before, complete with several spare tubes.
data.article: The ESR Analyzer is a specialized medical device required for Lance's A Reveal in Ruins quest. You can find this item by searching pharmacies located within the Buried City map. Placing the item in your safe pocket will prevent it from being lost if you are defeated.

data.name: Exodus Modules
data.description: Used to craft a wide range of items.
data.flavor_text: Used to craft: Tempest, Vulcano, Hullcracker, Bobcat, Snap Hook
data.article: Exodus Modules are essential for crafting advanced weapons and tools. They are also used to repair equipment and progress various Expedition and Trophy Display projects. You can obtain these modules by scavenging, finding them in Red Lockers, or purchasing them from Celeste, who offers one per day.

data.name: Exodus Technical Handbook
data.description: Filled with equal parts obscure jargon and complex diagrams.

data.name: Experimental Seed Sample
data.description: A cryogenically frozen research sample of an experimental crop.

data.name: Expired Pasta
data.description: Way pasta its prime.
data.article: Expired Pasta is a food item used to restore a Raider's health. It helps you recover during raids.

data.name: Expired Respirator
data.description: The filters are clogged with sand and noxious fumes. Long past its lifespan.

data.name: Expired Security Code
data.description: An expired security code. Has no more practical use.

data.name: Explosive Compound
data.description: Used to craft explosives.
data.article: Explosive Compound is a refined material used to create various types of explosives. Raiders can obtain it by looting arcs, such as the Comet, or by searching in industrial and security areas and opening metal crates. It can also be crafted at a Refiner using other materials. This item is a key component for crafting explosives at an Explosives Station level 1. Additionally, it can be recycled into other materials or salvaged from other items.

data.name: Explosive Mine
data.description: A proximity-triggered mine that pops up and explodes, dealing damage to anything within its radius.
data.article: The Explosive Mine is a device that triggers and explodes when ARCs enter its range, dealing damage to targets in that area. Raiders can craft this item at an Explosives Station level 1 after learning the Explosive Mine Blueprint. This item can also be recycled for resources or salvaged for materials.

data.name: Explosive Mine Blueprint
data.description: Lets you craft an Explosive Mine
data.article: The Explosive Mine Blueprint is a blueprint that lets you craft Explosive Mines at an Explosives Station. An Explosive Mine is a device that detonates when enemies enter its detection radius, releasing a blast that damages targets in the vicinity.

data.name: Extended Barrel I
data.description: Slightly increases bullet velocity & distance until damage falloff.
data.article: The Extended Barrel I is a weapon attachment. Attachments like this can be used to influence various aspects of a weapon's performance.

data.name: Extended Barrel II

data.article: Extended Barrel II is a blueprint component mentioned in overviews discussing new blueprints. It is part of a series of similar items, alongside Extended Barrel I and Extended Barrel III.

data.name: Extended Barrel II Blueprint
data.description: Lets you craft an Extended Barrel II
data.article: The Extended Barrel II Blueprint is a blueprint that, once acquired, permanently unlocks your ability to craft the Extended Barrel II at a crafting station in your Hideout whenever you have the required materials.

data.description: Significantly increases bullet velocity & distance until damage falloff.

data.name: Extended Barrel III Blueprint
data.description: Lets you craft an Extended Barrel III
data.article: The Extended Barrel III Blueprint is a blueprint that allows you to craft an extended barrel attachment at the Workbench. It improves how fast bullets travel from your weapons.

data.name: Extended Burst Cycles
data.description: A burst has a beginning, a middle, and an end. The middle could probably use more bullets. Let's investigate.

Extended Light Mag I is a Weapon Mod that makes compatible weapons hold slightly more ammunition. It adds 5 to the magazine size of compatible weapons.

You can find this mod by scavenging, or craft it at a Gunsmith bench level 1. It is also sold by the vendor Tian Wen for 1,920 coins, with a limit of 5 per day.

data.name: Extended Light Mag II
data.description: Moderately extends the ammo capacity of compatible weapons that use light ammo.
data.article: The Extended Light Mag II is a weapon modification that increases the amount of ammunition a compatible weapon can hold. It adds 10 rounds to a weapon's magazine capacity. To craft this modification, you need the Extended Light Mag II Blueprint and access to a crafting station. This item can also be recycled to recover some resources.

data.name: Extended Light Mag II Blueprint
data.description: Lets you craft a Extended Light Mag II
data.article: The Extended Light Mag II Blueprint is a blueprint that allows you to craft the Extended Light Mag II weapon mod at a Gunsmith Bench, which helps by increasing the ammo capacity of compatible weapons. Blueprints for gun parts, such as this one, are typically found when scavenging Raider Containers, which can appear in any map. They may also be obtained as a reward from Trials. Once you use a blueprint, it is consumed and the recipe becomes permanently available for crafting. If you find a blueprint you already know, it can be sold for 5,000 coins.

data.name: Extended Light Mag III
data.description: Significantly extends the ammo capacity of compatible weapons that use light ammo.
data.article:
The Extended Light Mag III is a weapon modification that increases the ammunition capacity of compatible weapons.

You can craft the Extended Light Mag III at a Gunsmith Bench level 1 after acquiring the Extended Light Mag III Blueprint.

data.name: Extended Light Mag III Blueprint
data.description: Lets you craft a Extended Light Mag III
data.article: The Extended Light Mag III Blueprint is a blueprint that allows you to craft the Extended Light Mag III modification at a Gunsmith Bench level 1. This weapon mod significantly increases the ammunition capacity of compatible weapons.

data.name: Extended Medium Mag I

data.article: Extended Medium Mag I is a weapon modification. It helps by increasing the ammunition capacity for weapons that use medium ammo.

stat_block.compatibleWeapons: Arpeggio, Osprey, Renegade, Torrente, Tempest, Venator

data.article:
The Extended Medium Mag II is a weapon modification that moderately increases the amount of ammo your compatible weapons can hold. This allows you to fire more shots before needing to reload.

You can obtain this mod by scavenging in the world. It can also be crafted at a Gunsmith station using the Extended Medium Mag II Blueprint and various other materials. Additionally, the vendor Shani sells this mod for 100 coins, with a daily limit of two per Raider. If you no longer need it, this mod can be recycled into other resources.

data.name: Extended Medium Mag II Blueprint
data.description: Lets you craft a Extended Medium Mag II
data.article: The Extended Medium Mag II Blueprint is a blueprint that allows you to create the Extended Medium Mag II at a crafting station with a Gunsmith skill level of 2. This weapon attachment increases the ammo capacity of compatible weapons that use medium ammo, letting you fire more shots before needing to reload. You can purchase this blueprint from the vendor Shani for 100 coins, with a daily limit of two. It can also be found through scavenging.

data.name: Extended Medium Mag III
data.description: Significantly extends the ammo capacity of compatible weapons that use medium ammo.
data.article: The Extended Medium Mag III is a weapon mod. Its main purpose is to increase the amount of ammunition a compatible weapon can hold, allowing for more shots before reloading. This mod is crafted at Gunsmith Bench level 1 using the Extended Medium Mag III Blueprint. If you have extra units of this mod, you can recycle or salvage it to recover various other resources.

data.name: Extended Medium Mag III Blueprint
data.description: Lets you craft the Medium Mag III
data.article:
This is a blueprint that allows you to craft the Extended Medium Mag III weapon mod at a Gunsmith bench. Once crafted, it helps your compatible weapons hold a significantly larger amount of ammunition.

For a better chance to find the Extended Medium Mag III Blueprint, focus on Night Raids or Electromagnetic Storms, and target high-value loot zones or Residential-style containers, including suitcases on Spaceport and cupboards on Buried City Night Raid.

data.name: Extended Shotgun Mag I
data.description: Slightly extends the ammo capacity of shotguns.
data.article: The Extended Shotgun Mag I is a weapon modification designed to slightly extend the ammo capacity of compatible shotguns. Equipping this mod allows Raiders to carry more ammunition in their weapon, reducing the frequency of reloads during combat encounters.

data.name: Extended Shotgun Mag II
data.description: Moderately extends the ammo capacity of shotguns.
data.article: The Extended Shotgun Mag II is a weapon modification that increases the amount of ammunition a compatible weapon can hold. This helps you carry more ammunition into raids before needing to reload or resupply. You can craft this item at a Gunsmith station once you have its blueprint, using various resources. It can also be recycled for resources.

data.name: Extended Shotgun Mag II Blueprint
data.description: Lets you craft a Extended Shotgun Mag II - Moderately extends the ammo capacity of shotguns.
data.article: The Extended Shotgun Mag II Blueprint is a blueprint that allows you to craft the Extended Shotgun Mag II weapon mod at a Gunsmith bench level 1. This mod moderately increases the ammo capacity of shotguns. Blueprints can be obtained through scavenging, by completing Weekly Trials or projects, or as rewards from Quests. Certain ARCs can also drop blueprints. Unwanted blueprints can be sold for 5,000 coins.

data.name: Extended Shotgun Mag III Blueprint
